photo: Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35 mm lens on a tripod at eye level, straight verticals, natural colour, fine film grain, true-to-life materials and honest exposure. No text, no logos, no watermark, no border.
keep: Keep the exact same camera position, lens, framing and perspective, and keep every object, shape, edge, texture and material exactly where and as it is. Do not add, remove, move or resize anything. Change only the light.
